items.exampleEn: Our dog likes to sleep on its belly.
The baby has food all over her chin.
items.exampleZh: 寶寶的下巴沾滿了食物。

items.exampleEn: Looking down from tall buildings makes me dizzy.
items.exampleZh: 從高樓往下看會讓我頭暈。

items.exampleEn: My uncle has an unhealthy lifestyle.
items.exampleZh: 我叔叔的生活方式很不健康。

items.exampleEn: Please don't park in handicapped spaces.
items.exampleZh: 請不要把車停在身障車位。（handicapped 是較舊的說法，現多用 disabled）

items.exampleEn: My son cried all night because of a toothache.
items.exampleZh: 我兒子因為牙痛哭了一整晚。

items.exampleEn: My little brother often gets a stomachache before tests.
items.exampleZh: 我弟弟考試前常常肚子痛。

items.sentenceEn: He hurt his chin when he fell from his bike.
items.sentenceZh: 他從腳踏車上摔下來時傷到了下巴。

items.audioEn: I can't go to the party tonight because I have a toothache.
items.audioZh: 我今晚不能去派對，因為我牙痛。
items.questionZh: 說話的人為什麼不能去派對？
options: Because of work at the office

items.sentenceEn: The plants looked unhealthy after the hot summer.
items.sentenceZh: 炎熱的夏天過後，這些植物看起來病懨懨的。

items.sentenceEn: The heat made me feel dizzy.
items.sentenceZh: 炎熱的天氣讓我覺得頭暈。

items.stemEn: I ate too much at dinner, and now I have a ____.
items.stemZh: 我晚餐吃太多，現在肚子痛。

items.stemEn: I stood up too fast and felt ____.
items.stemZh: 我站起來太快，覺得頭暈。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, Mia went on a boat trip with her friends. The boat moved up and down a lot, and Mia felt dizzy. Then she ate some fried snacks and got a stomachache. Her friend Kate laughed and said, "Your belly isn't happy today!" On the way home, Mia fell and hurt her ankle. It was not her day.
items.passageZh: 上週末，Mia 和朋友們去搭船出遊。船一直上下晃動，Mia 覺得頭暈。後來她吃了一些炸的點心，結果肚子痛了。她的朋友 Kate 笑著說：「妳的肚子今天不太開心喔！」回家的路上，Mia 又跌倒扭傷了腳踝。那天她真是諸事不順。

questions.questionZh: 回家的路上發生了什麼事？
options: Mia 錯過了回家的最後一班公車

items.promptZh: 這棟大樓有身障人士專用的入口。
referenceEn: This building has an entrance for handicapped people.
There is an entrance for handicapped people in this building.
rubricZh: 「身障人士」可寫例如 handicapped people（寫 disabled people、people with disabilities 也正確）
「專用的入口」可寫 an entrance for…

referenceEn: I had a bad toothache yesterday.
Yesterday I had a terrible toothache.
rubricZh: 用 have a toothache 表示「牙痛」，昨天的事用過去式（例如 had）
「很厲害」可寫，例如 bad、terrible 等
